# Measures & References {.unnumbered}

All measures are drawn from existing, validated instruments, with one documented exception:
the Week 4 Feedback Orientation items are author-created for this course (no validated bipolar
supportive/corrective scale exists). See the
companion strategy document (*FRI PM Mindsets Strategy*) for the full item bank, scoring, and
access status.

## Measure by week

| Week | Mindset | Instrument · subscale | Access |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Purposeful Peer Mentoring | Mentoring Competency Assessment (Fleming et al., 2013) | Free |
| 1 | Mentoring Style | Mentoring Style Values Inventory (adapted from Ertesvåg, 2011) | Adapted |
| 2 | Motivational Style | Mentoring Regulatory Focus 2×2 (adapted; Higgins, 1997; Lockwood et al., 2002) | Adapted |
| 3 | Leadership Focus | Promotion/Prevention Team Leadership Scale (adapted) | Adapted |
| 4 | Feedback Orientation | Feedback Orientation, bipolar (author-created for this course) | Author-created |
| 5 | Feedback Purpose | Dual-Role FOS (2025); Teachers' Conceptions of Assessment (Brown, 2006) | © |
| 6 | Leadership Role | SPLIT, full inventory (Grille & Kauffeld, 2015; cf. Hiller et al., 2006) | © |
| 7 | Leadership Target | SPLIT · task & relation subscales (Grille & Kauffeld, 2015) | © |
| 8 | Inclusive Mentoring | Culturally Aware Mentorship Self-Efficacy (Byars-Winston & Butz, 2021) | Free *(proposed)* |
| 9 | Conflict Mediator | Dutch Test for Conflict Handling (DUTCH), short form (De Dreu et al., 2001) | Free (© article) |
| 10 | Goal Preference | TCoA (Brown, 2006); Outcome and Process Scale (2017); Work Domain Goal Orientation (VandeWalle, 1997) | © |
| 11 | Communicator | Nonviolent Communication Behaviors Scale (Cheung et al., 2022) | © |
| 12 | People Orientation | 'Kind of Person' Implicit Theory Scale (Dweck, 1999) | Free |
| 13 | Self-Awareness | SRIS · Insight (Grant et al., 2002); MCA · Fostering Independence (Fleming et al., 2013); four-type framework from Eurich (2018) | Free / © |
| 14 | Paradoxical | Paradox Mindset Scale, 9-item (Miron-Spektor et al., 2018) | © |

**Access legend.** Free = freely available for research and education. © = copyrighted, items
typically in the source article, free for non-commercial research with citation (verify terms).
Licensed = commercially licensed, purchase or permission required. Adapted = adapted from a
copyrighted instrument (cite the original).

::: {.callout-note}
## Parked measures
The Five-Dimensional Curiosity Scale (Kashdan et al., 2020) and the Mentor Self-Efficacy Scale
are no longer part of the Table 1 curriculum. Their item banks are retained in the strategy
document under **Parked measures** in case a week is reassigned.
:::
